hedging_delta.evidence: Similar levels of 'expect', 'believe', 'we forecast' language used in both calls' guidance sections.

guidance_direction.evidence: Prior guided Q4 midpoint ~$13.3B; current guides Q1 midpoint $12.2B with gross margin down to 34.5% from 36.5% guide, driven by supply constraints most acute in Q1.

quant_claim_escalation.evidence: CapEx previously expected 'down' for 2026; now guided to 'flat to down slightly,' a less favorable capital efficiency trajectory.

new_topic_rate.evidence: New substantive discussion of custom ASIC run-rate exceeding $1B annualized and $100B TAM opportunity, and Investor Day announcement, both absent from prior call.

tone_delta.evidence: Current call adds more caution: 'disappointed that we are not able to fully meet the demand,' 'still below what I want them to be,' more restrained than prior's confident tone.

demand_language_delta.evidence: Prior call: CPU TAM 'cautiously optimistic' will grow; current call cites supply constraints depleting buffer inventory and revenue decline in CCG guided for Q1, plus new component pricing risk from DRAM/NAND/substrates.
